node.title: Re: Any good ways to handle NARROW NO-BREAK SPACE characters in regex in newer versions of Perl?
node.author: ikegami
node.doctext:
\s matches whitespace characters, which includes U+202F NARROW NO-BREAK SPACE. $ perl -le'print "\x{202F}" =~ /^\s\z/ ? "match" : "no match"' match

Do you have a NNBSP, or do you have its UTF-8 encoding? Don't forget to decode your inputs (and encode your outputs)!

If you need further help, please provide the output of sprintf( "%vX", $_ ) for a string that supposedly includes a NNBSP.
